what.text: This page follows refugees from Sierra Leone living in Guinea, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1650 Sierra Leonean refugees in Guinea, 18.5% of all refugees from Sierra Leone.
France hosts the most Sierra Leonean refugees, followed by Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone in every year from 1991 to 2001, with the RUF and AFRC among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1995 to 2000, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 142601 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 370631, at the end of 1999, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Guinea.
These are year-end totals for Guinea only, reported to UNHCR.
